title: At the Superstore
context: You are in a Canadian grocery store. A clerk offers to help you find rice and bread.

turns.text: Hi there, can I help you find something in the grocery aisles today?
Yes please. I need a bag of rice and a loaf of fresh bread.
Rice is in aisle 4, next to the dairy.
Thanks. The flyer had a sale — is the rice on discount?
Yes, it's on sale this week. The cashier takes it off at checkout.
Perfect. I'll grab a cart and meet you at checkout.
See you at checkout. Don't forget your grocery bag.

choices: A bag of rice and a loaf of fresh bread
questions.explanation: The customer asked for a bag of rice and a loaf of fresh bread.
The clerk said rice is in aisle 4, next to the dairy.

questions.prompt: Why did the clerk mention a sale?
choices: The customer asked about a flyer sale on rice
The cashier was on a break
questions.explanation: The customer mentioned the flyer sale; the clerk confirmed the rice is on discount this week.

dictation_segments.text: Rice is in aisle 4, next to the dairy.
Yes, it's on sale this week.
